On this plot I will mainly rely on cassava and sweet potato mixed with a few intercrops, because here in Mwanza the rains are seasonal and these crops manage better when the season is uncertain. I do not usually have enough cash for chemical fertilizer or irrigation, so I will use what I can from home, especially some manure, and depend mostly on family labor with a little hired help at land preparation and weeding. I will plant the local planting material I know well and only use chemicals if there is a serious problem, which I do not expect this season.
